summary: Norfolk yeoman who died young at Tharston in 1618, leaving a widow and five small children; John's 12th-great-grandfather.
bio: Henry Tuthill was baptized on 18 June 1581 at Saxlingham Thorpe and Nethergate, Norfolk, England, the child of John Tuttill. He later moved about three miles to Tharston, where he was known as Henry Tuthill of Tharston. He died young: his will, dated 20 March 1618, was proved on 20 April 1619, and he was buried at Tharston on 26 March 1618. The will names his wife Alice and their five children, his brother John Tuthill, his father-in-law John Gooch, his mother-in-law Margaret Raue and a kinswoman, Ann Woodyard. He is John's 12th-great-grandfather.
